Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, the camera's all ready!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're almost finished with our exact replica of the Temple of Angkor Wat, constructed entirely out of playing cards. Hey, where's Candace? I bet she'd love to see this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Does He Think You're Pretty Enough? Ten Ways You Could Be.. Better." Wow. Ten ways? Thank you Quazmo Magazine. (cell phone rings) Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Umm, so listen. I'm really sorry, but something's come up and I won't be able to make it to our date tonight. I hope you understand. (Candace doesn't respond) Hello? ...Candace, are you there? ...Hello?...Helloo? Well, I guess we got cut off.

Name: Candace
Dialog: He just broke our date and hung up on me. Oh, it's probably not as bad as I think. Let's see what Quazmo has to say about it. (The headline on the front over of the magazine reads: How To Tell When It's Over. Candace starts whimpering)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Last card. You do the honors, Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Here's where Candace goes berserk. She screams loudly at the top of her lungs)

Name: Tarzan look alike
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Umm, hey, Candace. Everything okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Beat it, dweebs! I'm having a crisis!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds like Candace is in a serious funk. I wonder what we can do to snap her out of it?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh, I know! It's all right here in Tween Bleep magazine. "Three Sure-Fire Ways to Lift Your Friend Out of a Serious Funk. Number one: Give her a complete make-over. A completely different look will often do the trick."

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A completely different look? Come on, Ferb. We need somebody who's good with make-up and fancy hair-dos.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Umm, okay. I'll just stay here with my "Expert Makeover" patches and... Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, uuh, well, due to your...reprehensible behavior over the past few days, (screen changes to Perry robot kicking over a trash can) which I can still barely believe is even possible (changes to fake Perry stealing cash out of a truck) from an agent of your caliber, (changes to fake him throwing money out the window of a car, then to him eating cereal at his host family's table but that Doofenshmirtz's home and Doofenshmirtz's table)  who has been nothing but the best in his field I, uhh, uh, actually, I don't know what's particularly bad about this clip here, but, we have no choice but...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Why? Why'd you do it?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Not yet, Carl. Wait till I'm done here. (to Perry) You are officially.. discharged. (to Carl) Okay, now, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Why? Why'd you do it?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Cuff him, boys.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Red alert! Red alert! Renegade agent on the run!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, Jeremy has, like, totally lost interest in me!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What makes you think so?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Quazmo magazine!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I'll be right there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, that was almost impossibly fast.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, wait! You're not Stacy! Hey, hey, hey! What is going on? Huh? (Clown pulls out a pie) Uh, wait a minute. Now, don't try anything funny! (Pie splashes in her face)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So, are you ready for some cheering up?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She then looks in mirror and starts screaming loudly again, birds fly, dogs bark, seals jump in water, monkeys beat up Tarzan look-alike.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No biggie, Shlocko, you gave it your best shot.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In hindsight, a clown may not have been the best choice to do a makeover.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ya think?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what else does the magazine say?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: "Step number two: Make her laugh. Laughter is the best medicine."

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure! Make her laugh. Candace has a great sense of humor. Remember that time she got her face caught in the sink?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, how 'bout now we get you some ice cream?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know, Stacy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good afternoon, ladies.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Or we can do this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We have a table reserved for you close to the stage, Miss Flynn.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh. This is SO cool.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On microphone) Hey, hey, hey, hey, everybody! We havin' fun yet? First up, our favorite math-formula funny man, Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Holding a plastic dummy that looks just like him) Thank you. Thanking you much. So little Jeet, I hear you went to New Delhi. And did you try the chicken club?

Name: Little Jeet
Dialog: Wow, that's really what you're going with? You know, just do the water drinking bit.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Okay. The Pythagorean theorem...

Name: Little Jeet
Dialog: The square of the hypotenuse of a right triang... (coughs then head falls off, then Baljeet coughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's hear it for the dummy! And that puppet wasn't bad either.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Next up, my favorite vegetable-based comic, Broccoli Top!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm gonna do some prop comedy for you, and you're gonna like it! Okay, what have we got? (reaches into the box and gets a house) Here's a...here's a house. For, uh...I don't know. A mouse or something. (drops and breaks house; gets a book from his box) Here's a book. Hey, what am I...what am I supposed to do? Read? (throws book) Next! All right, let's see what else we've got! Um, and here's, uh, um... (gets out an oyster shell) Oh! An oyster shell, look! My...my mom went to a seafood restaurant...I don't have any...it's just...to me, it's just interesting. I'll put that one back in the box. (puts shell back in box) What else we got? Oh, here we go. Look! (pulls out Baljeet) A nerd to go with the book!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am in both acts!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (throws Baljeet off stage and onto Ferb's drum set) Thank you! Buford's still in the building!

Name: Candace
Dialog: This isn't making me feel any better.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? You wanna wrestle?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Coming up next, Ferb Fletcher!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Ahem. So, how about that airline food?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (not laughing along) This, is making me feel worse.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (still laughing along) Ahahaha, what's airline food?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Worried) Doesn't look like it's working.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what does it say for step number three?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It says... "Introduce her to someone new."

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That should be easy. There are lots of nice people in Danville that she's never met. Ferb, I've got an idea.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey fellas! Look who decided to make an appearance. (to Perry) You see, it occurred to me that what I should really be doing is fighting fire with fire. And by fire, I mean Perry the Platypus. And by fire, I ALSO mean Perry the Platypus. It occurred to me while I was on fire. I made a bunch of doppelgangers to discredit and totally destroy you. Behold the Plata-Proliferator-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Meet Terry the Platypus, and say hello to Larry the Platypus, and say aloha to Jerry the Platypus. (shows distorted Perry lookalike) Yeah, he was the first one out of the batch, but you know, he was so cute, I couldn't bear to...(Jerry hits Doofenshmirtz with the pipe he was drooling on) Ow! Ow! No, no, Jerry, you do not hit people. You do not... (Jerry hits him again) Ow! No, use your words, Jerry. (talks to the Perry lookalikes) Anyway, all you guys, go get him!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He-ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Awwwww.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look at this, Stacy, he won't even answer his cell phone.

Name: Little Jeet
Dialog: Excuse me, Miss Flynn? You and a guest are cordially invited to the Mixer Mingler.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mixer Mingler? Say, aren't you that dummy from the night club?

Name: Little Jeet
Dialog: She's talking to you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's obviously some lame attempt by my brothers to cheer me up. I'm not going.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Come on; it will do you good.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as they climb up the machine) Oh, would you look at this? If I wasn't so depressed, my brothers would be so busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: With the Mix 'n' Mingler, you can meet someone new every two seconds. Now, let's fire this baby up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fasten your seatbelts!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe I'm doing... (The machine starts spinning) AHHHHH!

Name: Chorus
Dialog: (background chanting) Mix, mingle, mix, mingle

Name: Candace
Dialog: I like your pants?

Name: Man 3
Dialog: Here, you can take 'em.

Name: Rooster
Dialog: Yeah, I'm followin' him.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You forgot your socks.

Name: Man 9
Dialog: I need a hug.

Name: Creepy man
Dialog: Esh, eesh eesh eesh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Next!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mix, mingle, mix, mingle, mix, mingle, mix, mingle.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Jerry? Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, folks. Prepare for emergency ejection. (pulls a cord)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In hindsight, a simple ice cream cone might have been more effective.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: See?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (tearing up) Congratulations, Agent P! I knew it couldn't be you causing all that trouble! (sobs) You are officially... reinstated!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know, a little ice cream always makes me feel better.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe you're right. I'll have two scoops of...Jeremy? (Jeremy turns around) Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you doing here?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I didn't wanna break our date. I just wanted to earn some extra money, so I could surprise you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A surprise, for me? Oh, Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Jeremy! This was so worth the wait.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm just glad you're not one of those people who freaks out just because someone cancels a date.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughs awkwardly; tosses magazine over her shoulder) Riiiiiiight.
